title: Defend: GCM decrypt batch accumulation is architecturally required
description: wolfssl_aes_gcm.c — the decrypt path accumulates the entire ciphertext in ctx->inbuf and only decrypts in finalize() after tag verification. A reviewer might suggest 'decrypt incrementally during update() and let the caller handle the tag mismatch error'. This is wrong: releasing unauthenticated plaintext before tag verification is a security vulnerability — callers that process the plaintext before read() returns (or before checking the return code from finalize()) would operate on potentially maliciously modified data. The batch-decrypt-then-verify model is the only safe design. The comment in wolfssl_aes_gcm_update documents this requirement explicitly. The AEAD SECURITY REQUIREMENT section in crypto2dev_provider.h §finalize also documents the constant-time tag comparison requirement.
close_reason: Code verified correct. Rationale comments present in source.
